== Description ==

[[Ming Huo]] (front left, grey T-shirt) playing [[Kyle Krueger]] (front right, grey T-shirt), with [[Benji Chu]] in the background at right, at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025; other background faces unlabeled.
